use_case_summary: Sunridge is building an in-product AI assistant for their mid-market customers to surface contextual answers from product docs and support history, plus a summarization feature for long customer threads. Workload is mixed: high volume short chat queries (support-agent) plus lower-volume long summarization jobs and periodic embedding/reindexing jobs.
capacity_forecast: Hosted trial (2 weeks observed): avg QPS 3.8, daily peak QPS 18, avg tokens/call 340 (prompt ~120 / completion ~220), nightly embedding batch jobs ~60k tokens/min for reindexing.
Prod month-0 (expected immediate ramp): sustained QPS 25, 95th percentile QPS 72, short 30-min spikes to 150 QPS during peak support windows, avg tokens/call 380.
Concurrency target for Dedicated: typical concurrency 40-60, expected peak concurrent requests 180 during promotional campaigns, keep 99% requests under 500ms p95 for short queries.
Token mix projection: 70% short interactions (<200 tokens total), 25% medium (200-800 tokens), 5% long (>800 tokens) for deep summaries and code-assist flows.
Embeddings workload: nightly incremental reindexing ~1.2M tokens/day; initial full reindex estimated at 15M tokens (one-off).
SLA needs: regional routing to NA, fallback to lower-capacity model under degraded conditions, audit logs for all production calls retained 90 days in managed logging and 7 years for event traces.
Redwood sizing ask: propose Dedicated config to support sustained 25 QPS with room for 6x burst headroom -> initial reserved capacity equivalent to 4 inference instances with autoscale burst to 8.
poc_results: Latency (hosted): short chat p50 120ms p95 460ms; long-summary p50 540ms p95 1.9s.
Quality: model A (open-6B-quant) acceptable on knowledge retrieval but hallucinated product-specific entities in 2% of responses; requested fine-tune/rlhf guidance.
Cost: hosted trial burn rate extrapolated to ~$18k/mo at projected month-0 traffic; Redwood Dedicated estimate reduces unit cost by ~35% at proposed commit (matches finance threshold).
Stability: 1 intermittent 5-min outage during trial due to region quota hit; customer asked for capacity reservation and routing policy to avoid user-facing errors.
Integration notes: SSO/SAML flow tested on staging; logs push to customer's S3 verified; KMS key rotation questions remain.
Action items from POC: collect 7-day request distribution for better batching config, run targeted long-tail prompt suite to validate p95 under Dedicated tuning.
